channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Bengals cancel trade with Eagles over draft pick protection
item.description: The Cincinnati Bengals have backed out of a trade with the Philadelphia Eagles that would have sent defensive end Arnold Ebiketie to the Eagles. The Bengals' decision was made to protect a 2027 compensatory draft pick. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Vincent Kompany, the manager of Bayern Munich, returned to the club's training ground with his arm in a sling. The reason for his injury was not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Buffalo Bills secured a 23-6 victory over the Minnesota Vikings in a Monday Night Football game. The Bills' defense played a key role in turning the game around, contributing to the win that moved the Bills to a 7-1 record. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Edmonton Elks and Montreal Alouettes football teams have arrived in Calgary for the 113th Grey Cup championship game. As part of a tradition, a horse named Taffy is scheduled to be led through a Calgary hotel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Quarterback Kirk Cousins has been reacquired by the Minnesota Vikings in a trade with the Las Vegas Raiders. The deal occurred at the NFL trade deadline. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Iowa State defeated No. 24 Oklahoma State 51-49 after Konrardy kicked a field goal as time expired. The victory was secured on the final play of the game. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: FC Barcelona secured a decisive 6-1 victory over Alaves in a La Liga match, with Lamine Yamal and Raphinha each scoring twice. The win allowed Barcelona to maintain their position at the top of the league standings. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Namibia wins maiden ODI series against Ireland
item.description: Namibia has secured its first-ever bilateral One Day International (ODI) series win, defeating Ireland 3-2. This victory is seen as a significant boost for Namibia's preparations for the upcoming ICC men's cricket World Cup. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Biten Singh Wins Ironman 70.3 Goa, Sets New Course Record
item.description: Indian Army athlete Biten Singh won the men's title at IRONMAN 70.3 Goa 2026, completing the race in 4 hours, 24 minutes, and 29 seconds. This time also set a new course record. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Canelo Alvarez Wins WBC Super Middleweight Title from Christian Mbilli
item.description: Canelo Alvarez defeated Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision to regain the WBC super middleweight title. The fight saw Alvarez secure a vital win, keeping his career prospects strong after dominating Mbilli. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ravens Quarterback Lamar Jackson Injured, Ruled Out of Game
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was ruled out of the game after sustaining an injury to his right throwing hand's thumb during the first play against the Buffalo Bills. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: South Carolina Defeats Oklahoma in College Football Game
item.description: South Carolina secured a 42-25 victory over Oklahoma in a college football game. LaNorris Sellers was a key player for South Carolina, leading the team to their third consecutive win. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Notre Dame Fighting Irish defeated the Villanova Wildcats 74-72 in their college basketball season opener, which took place in Rome. Pope Leo met with both the Villanova and Notre Dame basketball teams at the Vatican. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Johns Hopkins Wins Football Game on Rare Fair Catch Kick
item.description: Johns Hopkins secured a last-second victory over Muhlenberg in a Division III football game using a rare fair catch kick. This play had been out of college football for 76 years. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was hospitalized with a neck injury during a game against the Vikings. He was placed on a backboard and carted off the field after a tackle. Campbell is staying overnight at the hospital. As of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: West Indies defeat Bangladesh by eight wickets in first Test
item.description: The West Indies defeated Bangladesh by eight wickets in the first Test match held in Mirpur. This victory gives the West Indies a lead in the series. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Marc Marquez won the Malaysian Grand Prix, extending his lead in the MotoGP championship standings. The victory brings him closer to retaining his title. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
